headline: R-TYPE takes the high road: the Options capsule docks and mirrors
lede: An empty board sent the forge to R-TYPE's oldest honest gap — the arcade's O pod — and the shield-guns now answer: two golden orbs fly in, lock onto the hull's flanks, and fire on every press.

notes.text: The O pod rides leg 1 above the slab lip at camX 500: take it and two orbs sweep in over about two seconds, latch at diagonal mounts, and mirror the vulcan — one press, three rounds. With Double held, each orb mirrors the twin stack: the arcade's six-round shield-gun wall.

rtypecheck grew twelve #2919 laws and two named mutants (mirror-deaf, opts-leak) — 174 laws, 18 mutants, all red where they should be. The stream-integrity law proves the feature adds zero rng: 1400 shared ticks past the pod, hash-for-hash.

The orbs obey the house laws: spares pay points, the wreck strips them with the arm, seat two gets its own pair — and the winnability floors rose (solo 8/12, co-op 11/12) because the firepower is real.
Left standing on purpose: Half-Capsule (the capsule list's part 3) and the Option-launch drone throw are the shelf's next unowned gaps — the never-dry ladder already sees them.
